exchange._comment: Credentials come from environment variables HL_WALLET_ADDRESS and HL_PRIVATE_KEY (see .env.example). Never put keys in this file.

trading._comment: order_size is in base units (ETH here) per quote. order_size * price must exceed Hyperliquid's $10 minimum notional.

strategy._comment: gamma and k are in 1/USD (see hyperliquid_mm/strategy.py for the units convention). Higher gamma = wider spread and stronger inventory aversion. min_requote_seconds limits cancel/replace churn, which Hyperliquid meters per address.

risk._comment: At max_inventory_usd the bot stops adding and quotes reduce-only on the unwind side. If session equity drops by session_loss_limit_usd, the bot flattens the position and halts.
